column1: # name_in_kana answers read locally, 2026-08-04, from each work-file's own LEAD.
# Every reading below is the parenthetical the lead opens with. Where the lead
# gives two, the FIRST is taken (御香宮神社 ごこうのみや/ごこうぐう, 豊受大神宮 pattern).
#   Q11544511 機殿神社   — the joint article for 神服織機殿神社 + 神麻続機殿神社. Its lead
#                         opens with those two names, not its own; 「両社を合わせて
#                         両機殿（機殿神社）と呼ぶ」 is the only mention of the pair name
#                         and it carries no reading. Left pending on purpose.
#   Q7137401 水谷川忠起  — a PERSON (Meiji priest, 春日大社宮司), not a shrine. The
#                         reading みやがわ ただおき is right, but a shrine queue writing
#                         to a person item is a target-set defect to fix upstream,
#                         not to work around here. Left pending; see queue.md A0.
# Two that ARE answered but are not shrines either — Q5367406 春日山原始林 (a primeval
# forest) and Q7797685 宮中三殿 (the three palace sanctuaries). Their readings are
# plainly correct and P1814 is not shrine-specific, so they go out; they are noted
# because they show the same target-set leak as 水谷川忠起.
